name.description: Unique name of this buildbot worker. Must match the worker name registered with the Buildbot master.

password.description: Password used to authenticate with the Buildbot master. Should be a strong, randomly generated secret.

basedir.description: Absolute path to the directory where the worker will perform build steps and store state.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to the master. Set to 0 for unlimited. Most deployments use 1.

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive messages sent to the master to indicate the worker is alive.

keepalive_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a keepalive response before considering the connection dead and reconnecting.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to emit (CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG). Controls verbosity of worker logs.

debug.description: Enable additional debug logging. Not recommended for production unless troubleshooting.

tags.description: List of tags to associate with this worker. Masters can use tags to route builds to specific workers.

umask.description: Optional list of [dir_mode, file_mode] octal values to override default umask. Example: [0o755, 0o644]. Set to null to use system default.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Buildbot master server.

port.description: TCP port on which the Buildbot master listens for worker connections.

use_tls.description: If true, use TLS encryption for communication with the master (requires master TLS support).
